# Marked

The setup guides use the browser UMD build of Marked 18.1.0 from the official npm package.

- Project: https://github.com/markedjs/marked
- Package: https://registry.npmjs.org/marked/-/marked-18.1.0.tgz
- npm integrity: `sha512-PamYXWWWg2nboG3oX5Ffzpy3EFZROqZJK9hSlMmUnekp7TxPs5DcT95vwd46m73/exfKCRVMtgXoPMI4FEJL6w==`
- License: MIT; see LICENSE.md.

marked.umd.js, its source map, and the contents of LICENSE.md are copied unchanged from the package (the package's LICENSE file is saved as LICENSE.md). Keeping the renderer local lets the guides work without a third-party CDN.
